_provenance.notes: The Community Development Quota (CDQ) program was established in 1992 as part of the Magnuson-Stevens Act reauthorization to provide Western Alaska coastal communities a direct economic stake in the BSAI groundfish fisheries. 65 communities in Western Alaska are organized into 6 CDQ groups. They collectively receive 10% of all BSAI groundfish TACs plus significant crab allocations. Total CDQ revenues have exceeded $1.5 billion since 1992, providing direct employment and community infrastructure funding in some of Alaska's most remote communities.
